rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses (incl. audio and video presentations) from a Board-approved sponsor; clinical dental/dental hygiene or nonclinical subjects supporting clinical care (patient management, legal and ethical responsibilities, risk management, recordkeeping)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first renewal after initial licensure.
rules.carryover: Extra hours may be credited to the next renewal year, max 15 hours.
rules.alternatives: Up to 3 h for uncompensated care to low-income patients via a local health department or free clinic. Exemption (request 30 days before the deadline) or up to 1-year extension.
rules.audit_note: Board may audit after the renewal period; keep original records 4 years after renewal.
rules.notes: Annual renewal in the birth month (18VAC60-25-180). Current hands-on basic CPR for health care providers required. Monitoring sedation/GA patients: 4 h every 2 years. Remote supervision practice needs a one-time 2 h course.
